title: Storage test 'saves and reloads an item' fails intermittently
body:
## Summary
The storage test 'saves and reloads an item' failed once on a local run.

## Found in
Local run on a feature branch, 2026-09-18.

## Evidence
One failure, not reproduced.

## Acceptance
- The test passes 50 consecutive runs of `node --test test/storage.test.mjs`.

## Priority
later: seen once, not on main.
